Designer Plumbing Installations 
As Designer Plumbing Installations you will be focusing on designing systems that have sustainability and food security as starting points. 
( 17 augustus 2022 , Erik Schüssel ) 
For a client in the Delft region, active in the international high-tech horticultural sector, we are looking for a Designer Plumbing Installations. 
The Design Team works together with the Sales Department in drawing up quotations for customers globally. 
You will therefore be involved in making calculations, developing new systems, drawing up flow charts and visiting customers. You will be in frequent contact with colleagues and customers to ensure that the water systems or irrigation systems meet the customers' wishes. 
Who are we looking for in this position of Designer Plumbing Installations? 
- You have practical and technical insight 
- Completed technical education such as mechanical or installation engineering 
- Experience in water technology, installation technology or irrigation systems is a plus 
- You can speak English and Dutch is a nice to have 
You will be working in a team with 3 other colleagues with whom you will be working closely on challenging projects; every greenhouse needs a different system! 
There are many career opportunities and an attractive remuneration package (basic 35,000 - 50,000 euros/year, 32 days of holiday, travel allowance, pension scheme and a profit share scheme). 
Furthermore, as Designer Plumbing Installations you will be, on a daily basis, focusing on designing systems that have sustainability and food security as starting points.

Do you enjoy working with your hands and are you interested in high-tech technology? Then this could be your next step. As an Assembler at ASML, you will work on lithography machines that are used to produce microchips for the world's most advanced technologies. You will work in ASML's cleanroom factory, a unique and highly technological working environment where precision, quality, and teamwork are essential. You do not need to know everything from day one. At ASML, you learn by doing and develop your skills step by step through training, guidance, and hands-on experience. You will work closely with experienced colleagues and become part of a team that builds complex systems with the highest level of accuracy. Wie zoeken we? We are looking for someone who enjoys practical technical work and takes pride in delivering high-quality results. You are comfortable working with your hands, have an eye for detail, and understand the importance of working accurately when assembling complex systems. You enjoy working as part of a team and are willing to help colleagues when needed. At the same time, you take responsibility for your own work and are not afraid to ask questions or take initiative when you encounter a problem. You remain calm when priorities change and approach technical challenges in a practical and structured way. You are eager to learn and open to feedback. Whether you are already experienced in mechanical assembly or are looking to take the next step in your technical career, your motivation and willingness to develop are important. Education and technical experience A vocational qualification (MBO level 3 or 4) or a bachelor's degree in a technical field, such as Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automotive, Aerospace, or a comparable discipline. Hands-on experience in a technical production or service environment. Experience with mechanical assembly, testing, adjustment, and troubleshooting. Experience working with both larger mechanical components a

fine mechanical parts. Ability to read and understand technical drawings and work instructions. Good command of English, both written and spoken, for daily communication and documentation. Wat bieden wij je? As an Assembler at ASML, you will work in a unique high-tech environment where you can develop your technical skills and contribute to technology that is used all over the world. You will receive extensive training and guidance and have the opportunity to build a long-term career within an international organization. You can expect: A gross monthly salary of €3,771, excluding shift allowance. 25.1% shift allowance. An additional 0.65% ADV allowance. A 13th-month salary. An end-of-year bonus, based on company results. €0.21 per kilometre travel allowance, starting from 10 km one way. Extensive training and development opportunities. The opportunity to work in a highly advanced and innovative high-tech environment. Be Part of the Impact ASML develops and manufactures the world's most advanced lithography systems. These machines play a crucial role in the production of microchips, which are used in virtually all modern technologies. As an Assembler, you are an essential part of this process. Your craftsmanship, precision, and attention to detail ensure that complex components and systems are assembled correctly and meet ASML's high quality standards. Every component you assemble contributes to a larger system, and every system contributes to the technology that enables the next generation of microchips. Your hands. Your craftsmanship. Your impact on the technology of tomorrow. As an Assembler, you will build complex systems step by step, following clear work instructions and technical drawings. Do you have a passion for research and development? Are you eager to learn about the technology behind Lubricant Oil Additives and their application? Are you open to new opportunities and keen to develop yourself further? Read more below and find out that BRB is looking for you! 
 HBO 
 40 uur per week 
 Wat ga je doen 
What is the job about? 
In addition to supporting various research projects, you will also be responsible for the operational activities and organization of the laboratory. You identify gaps in current work processes and procedures and make suggestions for further improvements. 
You work on new as well as existing products and raw materials. You carry out a wide range of physical, chemical, analytical and performance tests, while collecting and reporting results. You do so in an effective and timely manner, prioritizing and meeting deadlines. 
You are responsible for the incoming control of research samples, ordering chemicals and consumables as well as equipment maintenance and calibration. You troubleshoot and diagnose equipment and systems for emergency repairs and carry out preventive maintenance inspections. It is important to balance lab organization and maintenance needs with the project workload while promoting a safe work environment and avoiding downtime. 
You will be doing hands-on research in the lab for about 80-90 % of your time. 
The team 
The R&D team you will join is fairly small and consists of six colleagues. It is a multicultural team and the working language is English. In this position you work closely with your colleagues and report directly to the line manager.
